description: Electric Vehicles by County is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Electric Vehicle data provided by Data.Wa.Gov. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are electric vehicle. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Data.WA.gov. The portal shows 2020-02-10 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
